anchored_pains.pain_title: Saved replies do not provide context-aware answers
quotes: Some people DM me asking super simple questions that are already answered on my website or booking page (like hours, prices, or services).

But despite this, I still get dozens of social media messages & emails a day (outside of our open hours and on days that we're closed) that seem to expect immediate answers or want to bypass staff and go straight to the owner with their basic question.

top.one_liner: Give founders a concrete, code-first migration path from Reddit bots blocked by API limits to maintainable Mastodon and Lemmy equivalents.

top.name: ChurnSignal Triage
top.one_liner: ChurnSignal Triage converts unanswered community questions into a transparent retention-risk queue, helping small teams intervene first where silence is most likely to precede cancellation.

top.name: GroundTruth Reply Check
top.one_liner: GroundTruth Reply Check compares every factual claim in an AI-drafted community reply with the company’s own documentation, showing exactly where the draft conflicts, lacks support, or matches.

top.name: ActivityBridge Router
top.one_liner: Give agencies one self-hosted, unlimited-seat queue for mainstream social inquiries by translating authorized platform activity into an ActivityPub workflow with accountable ownership and human-approved responses.

top.name: GapSignal
top.one_liner: Give small brands and nonprofits one daily Coverage Gap Score that reveals when news and social chatter diverge, so they can investigate overlooked risks and opportunities before responding.

evaluated_idea.name: ReplyMatch Policy-Safe Reddit Response Desk
evaluated_idea.value_proposition: Help small SaaS teams respond quickly to high-stakes Reddit questions with the current, approved product answer—and force an escalation when no defensible answer exists—instead of offering another generic social inbox or AI reply writer.
evaluated_idea.mechanism_summary: The wedge is not reply management or generic retrieval. It is a browser-native 'claim safety gate' for public Reddit responses: approved knowledge is treated as expiring, scoped policy evidence, and uncertainty is an explicit workflow outcome.

refinement.because: Fully automated replies publish confidently wrong answers
